For each route: the success path, an unknown id, invalid input where the method validates, and the answer to a non-admin user without rights (with a re-read proving nothing changed). The collection seeds its own data: `00 setup` creates a register, an admin-only schema, two objects and a non-admin user (ids kept in collection variables, suffixed with a per-run id), every folder creates whatever else it needs, and `99 teardown` deletes it all. It depends on no other collection.
